notes: Cats: Italy in the Régionale bank (61 stems, 11 of them central and southern, one of those the Montepulciano grape and town stem shared with Tuscany) and Italy Central & South in the Village bank (61 stems, 27 of them on the mainland south of Tuscany); no narrower category exists. Chapters: the Régionale chapter southitaly and the Village chapter Italy Central & South, whose facts 5, 7, 8 and 9 and traps 1, 3 and 4 are this subject. Regions: the four articles the index holds for the Court's regions, umbria for Sagrantino di Montefalco, abruzzo for Montepulciano d'Abruzzo (and the Marche next door in its exam lines), campania for the three Irpinian DOCGs and Vesuvius (and Basilicata's Vulture in its places), puglia for Primitivo; Marche, Basilicata and Calabria have no article of their own. Country: italy for the national ladder and the Superiore and Riserva terms. Grapes: Aglianico and Sagrantino, and Zinfandel for Primitivo, the only three of the Court's seven varieties with a profile; Fiano, Greco, Verdicchio and Montepulciano have none. Techniques: none, since the Court names no method for this subject. Service table: decanting, for the Court's young Taurasi and Sagrantino cell.
